description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin called 'editingblock' that manages the editing mode, data handling, and event management for an editing area within CKEditor. It includes plugin initialization, mode registration, mode switching, and event handling related to the editing interface.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current mode object for the editor based on the mode name.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor.prototype.addMode
methods.description: Registers a new editing mode with the editor.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor.prototype.setMode
methods.description: Sets the current editing mode of the editor, handling data loading and unloading.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor.prototype.focus
methods.description: Moves focus to the editor's editing area.
